subject: Payment gateway returning 502 across checkout
body: We are seeing a sharp increase in 502 responses from the primary payment gateway. Checkout attempts are failing for customers in the UK region. Started at approximately 09:40 UTC. Incident dashboard: payments-prod-eu-west-2.

subject: Warehouse sync delayed by 24 minutes
body: The outbound inventory feed has not completed its scheduled sync. Our warehouse team is unable to confirm pick lists for the morning dispatch window. Please investigate the integration queue.

subject: Identity provider unavailable for APAC tenants
body: Users across three APAC tenants cannot authenticate. SAML callbacks are timing out at the regional identity edge. Failover has not engaged; escalation bridge is open.

subject: Nightly export missing from shared drive
body: The 02:00 ET reconciliation export did not arrive in the shared reporting folder. The upstream job reports success, but no output file is present.

subject: Latency above threshold on customer API
body: P95 response time has remained above 1.8 seconds for approximately 12 minutes. Traffic is elevated but within forecast. No customer-facing errors have been confirmed yet.

subject: Request to update on-call contact list
body: Please update the distribution list for the weekend support rotation. The current contact for the infrastructure team is no longer active.

subject: Intermittent SFTP connection from branch office
body: File transfer connections from the Chicago branch are intermittently dropping. The issue affects two scheduled partner feeds and has self-recovered twice this morning.

subject: Certificate expiry warning for partner endpoint
body: The certificate for the partner ingestion endpoint expires in 7 days. Renewal was completed and validated against the staging endpoint.
